title: Tools for the crew
Broken axes, idle hands
summary: Half the tools of the {place}'s crew are broken. Bring {count} × {item} to {giver} in {settlement}.
{settlement} needs {count} × {item} so the {place} can go on.
offer: We've worn our tools to the haft on the {place}. {count} × {item} would put the crew back to work.
A builder without tools is just a person standing about. {count} × {item}, please.
complete: Fine tools. The {place} will be finished in no time.
These will last us years. Thank you.
